preconditions.description: The number of tiles n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(a in {1, 2} for a in a_list)
preconditions.description: Each tile value must be either 1 or 2.
The length of the input list must match the number of tiles n.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of the permutation of the input tiles.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(1, n + 1) if is_prime(sum(b_list[:i]))) == max_primes
postconditions.description: The number of prime prefix sums in the output must be maximized.
